modules.description: Payment voucher creation, digital signatures, bank-ready PDF output, and payment status tracking. Approvals run on the Novorit Authority engine; final money movement is handed off to a licensed bank.

modules.name: Novorit Procurement

modules.name: Novorit Compliance
modules.description: Regulator-ready compliance exports, audit-log delivery to your SIEM, signed access reviews, a separation-of-duties report, the decryption log, and controls monitoring with signed attestation — on top of the tamper-evident audit trail, nightly sealed evidence and data-subject request handling every plan includes

modules.name: Novorit Integrity
modules.description: Flags anomalies and control lapses for review across payments, orders, invoices, payees and sign-in — duplicate and split payments, duplicate invoices, amounts just under a limit, payee bank-detail changes, shared bank accounts, new suppliers paid quickly, very fast approvals, sanctions matches, non-compliant suppliers, dormant approvers and lapsed sign-in domains — each raised as a case someone takes, decides with a reason and closes, beside a live view of which controls are on.

modules.name: Novorit Grants
modules.description: Donor grant and restricted-fund tracking — allocate budgets per grant and tag spend against them for donor-ready reporting.
